_comment: Tool profiles for Jori's own MCP tool server (agent/tools-mcp). Each launcher of tools-mcp sets JORI_TOOL_PROFILE in its MCP config env; the server then lists AND serves only that profile's tools. A profile is `allow` (glob patterns; absent = every tool) minus `deny` (glob patterns), plus `homectl` = "read-only" | "off" for the homectl passthrough. Unset or unknown profile = "full" with a warning on stderr. An installation overrides or adds profiles in agent/local/config/tool-profiles.json (a top-level profile replaces the kernel one). Not a security boundary while the agent has Bash (bin/* reach the same actions); it removes the tool from the model's context and its call path. Derived from 30 days of real calls (2026-11-15). Design: docs/agent-secrets.md § Tool profiles.
